Dock 2 is closed until I authorize a controlled reopening, but the warehouse needs to keep processing outbound orders from the other docks in the meantime. Before I can issue that authorization, I need to follow our incident routine and check in with each of you: maintenance, warehouse logistics, fire protection, and training and staffing. Let's go around the room — can each of you give me your status and any findings related to this incident?
